auto.title: Automatic race sounds
auto.description: Plays only with an enabled director-PC audio receiver. Each trigger can be disabled independently. {driver}, {car} and {controller} are available for best laps, pit stops, tyre changes and damage; {lapTime} only for best laps. Missing details suppress speech. A pit stop does not confirm refuelling. Weather and damage are simulations.
auto.loadError: Could not load automatic sound settings.
auto.fuelDescription: Fuel warnings use virtual consumption only: once when crossing down to 20% or empty. They re-arm only after refilling above the respective threshold; a direct drop to empty triggers only the empty warning. Fuel events support {driver}, {car} and {controller}.

operatorHint: Tap a pad to play its sound on this device. Race controls and editing are not available here.
